question: What condition of suffering afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: The scope is specified as eighty-four thousand.
The locus of this condition is the womb-mechanisms.
Beings within this locus are described as tormented.
inference: Beings are subjected to torment throughout the vast array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
